lead_raw_text:
The structure of Li3Ag2Se4 crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with a 96-atom unit cell (Li36Ag24Se96) and four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived coordination analysis shows Ag centers in a tetrahedral environment with four Se neighbors, Li centers in an octahedral environment with six Se neighbors, and Se centers with three Li neighbors. The periodic neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 96 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-sharing between Ag tetrahedra and Li octahedra, and edge-sharing among Li octahedra.
